title: Critique: quasi-phenomenality does not leave room to wonder

statements.text: An adequate concept of phenomenal consciousness should leave a moment of epistemic room to wonder how it relates to function, the wonderfulness condition. Quasi-phenomenality, characterized by dispositions to make phenomenal judgments, closes the question of whether consciousness could exist without such dispositions, as in snails or unattended experience, so it is not the target concept.

sources.quote: does not appear to meet the wonderfulness condition
